name: AUTH-USER-SESSION
status: superseded by AUTH-USER-SESSION v0.2; retained for history

jwt.kid: configured allowlist; never load external keys from headers
jwt.subject: decimal user ID string
jwt.sid: random UUID string distinct per session

session.authority: user writes; validators read current authoritative state; no positive caching
session.binding: JWT sid/sub/scope must equal session sid/userId/scope; both expirations valid

errors.401: invalid signature, claims, scope, binding, missing, revoked or expired session
errors.503: authoritative session state unavailable; protected handler must not execute
errors.403: authenticated but forbidden by separate authorization layer

revocation: revoke current sid only; durable coordination and propagation are not implemented in G1
public_compatibility: existing public endpoints retain token header, code/msg/data wrapper, Long values as strings and nullable data omission
internal_types: new internal DTO IDs are decimal strings, bounded integers are JSON numbers, times ISO-8601 UTC unless JWT/session specifies Unix seconds
service_delegation: future distinct token_use=service/delegation; single target audience, independent machine authorization and actor-bound restricted delegation. No implementation or endpoint in this slice.
retry_idempotency: read retry bounded by caller budget; revocation should be idempotent; no blind write retry without durable guarantees
validation: isolated tests only; real Redis and cross-service integration pending
